note: One handshake, LP-10602. The RESP frame was written by github.com/luxfi/node/mesh/peer.RunPQHandshakeConn and the INIT frame is the one Go accepted; aead_key is the key GO derived, and both ends derived it. Both ML-DSA secrets are here so both signatures can be RE-MADE, which is what deterministic signing is for. Made with: pqgo <pub> <priv> '' 127.0.0.1:PORT   and   pq_vector_test --against 127.0.0.1:PORT <data dir>. Frames are message bodies: the 4-byte big-endian length that precedes each on the wire is not included.
